# CabacaTech

CabacaTech is the personal website and portfolio of Tiago Cabaça.

## About Tiago Cabaça

Tiago Cabaça is a computer engineering student at IADE, Universidade Europeia, in Lisbon, Portugal, taking a double degree in Computer Engineering and Management Informatics. He builds web applications, Android apps, backends and APIs, and runs a self-hosted homelab with two Proxmox servers. He is available for freelance work.

Main technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, PHP, Kotlin, Java, SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Docker, Linux, Proxmox VE and Git.

## Projects

- Fieldnote: distributed, fault-tolerant platform for diary studies (FastAPI, PostgreSQL with Patroni, RabbitMQ quorum queues, Garage S3, React Native). Academic, in development. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=fieldnote
- IADE Horarios: web app over the public IADE class timetables, with version history and comparison (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL). Live at https://iade-horarios.cabacatech.com. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=iade-horarios
- Homelab: two Minisforum MS-A1 servers with Proxmox VE, private by default, public sites through Cloudflare Tunnels. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=homelab-proxmox-servidorzinho
- CabacaLab: private cloud on the homelab with PostgreSQL, Redis, Garage S3, Caddy, Coolify and monitoring. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=cabacalab
- AEIADE website: new website of the IADE student association (Next.js, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL). In development. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=aeiade-website
- Mafra no Bolso: Android and iOS visit advisor for the municipality of Mafra (Flutter, Laravel, PostGIS). In development. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=mafra-no-bolso
- Africana Virtual Airways: virtual airline platform with multi-leg flight search, PNR bookings and an admin backoffice (PHP 8, MySQL). Academic. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=africana-virtual-airways
- PSP Lisboa App: native Android app built in 48 hours at the Tech4Good 2026 Tech Jam for a PSP challenge. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=psp-lisboa-app
- Track Manager: open source web app to manage audio and subtitle tracks in MKV and MP4 files (React, TypeScript, FastAPI, FFmpeg, MKVToolNix). https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=track-manager
- Xplored: Android app for discovering places with GPS check-in, points and route challenges (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Spring Boot, MySQL). Academic. https://cabacatech.com/pages/project-detail.html?id=xplored

## Blog

Articles in European Portuguese. Main series: "Diário do Homelab", seven parts on building and running a homelab (Proxmox, Minecraft servers, AdGuard Home DNS, operations, public sites without open ports, Jellyfin and TrueNAS, a second server). Start: https://cabacatech.com/pages/blog-post.html?id=como-comecei-o-meu-homelab

## Services

Freelance web development, UI/UX design, performance and technical SEO, and technical consulting.
